svg.title: Development Agent Ecosystem repository architecture
svg.desc: Large-scale repository architecture showing canonical configuration, prompts and skills, runtime compilation, eight standard agents plus host-compatible profiles, separate Reviewer and Review Verifier roles, review coverage and lifecycle artifacts, isolated task clones, and external Azure state.
svg.text: REPOSITORY COMPOSITION · COMPILED ROLES · RUNTIME STATE
One canonical JSON model compiles eight isolated roles and drives task-local artifacts, full repository clones, review verification, and Azure delivery.

g.text: Review coverage and exact verifier gate
Azure PR review and pipeline monitors
Reject unsafe ownership, secrets, or missing files
Require eight roles and ordered continuation
Compose canonical prompts and enabled skills
Generated files are derived, never canonical
Task state, artifacts, logs, and local diff
Canonical prompts, skills, sandbox, model route, and required artifacts
Private checkpoints · public role outcomes · final summary
Review snapshots · reviewCoverage · findingLifecycle · exact-SHA verification
Full-clone manifests · run/lease state · decisions · debt · pipeline evidence
Exact commit runs · stages · bounded logs
Immutable review history and verifier artifact
No plaintext secrets in JSON, prompts, or logs
